# Priyansh Khandal

> MCA graduate student, EC-Council Certified SOC Analyst (CSA), and Detection Engineer specializing in SIEM telemetry, Sigma rule authoring, digital forensics, and blue team operations.

Priyansh Khandal (handle: rootwithkhandal) is a cybersecurity defensive specialist and Master of Computer Applications (MCA) graduate student. He focuses on enterprise security operations (SOC), host telemetry ingestion, automated incident triage pipelines, and memory forensics.

## Core Technical Competencies & Tooling
- **SIEM & Log Correlation:** Splunk Enterprise / SPL, Wazuh EDR & XDR, Elastic Security / EQL.
- **Host & Network Telemetry:** Sysmon, Windows Security Event Logs (EID 1, 3, 10, 4624, 4625), Linux auditd, Zeek, Wireshark.
- **Detection Engineering:** Sigma rule development, YARA signatures, MITRE ATT&CK enterprise adversary mapping.
- **Digital Forensics & Triage:** Volatility 3 (live memory dump analysis, process injection, unmapped RWX pages), KAPE, artifact timeline extraction.
- **SecOps Scripting & Automation:** Python (pandas, scapy, requests), PowerShell, REST Threat Intelligence APIs (VirusTotal, AbuseIPDB, Shodan), MISP.

## Key SOC Projects
- [SIEM Triage Pipeline](https://khandal.tech/projects/siem-triage): Python and SPL automated alert triage and correlation engine reducing false-positive rates by 68%.
- [Enterprise Sigma Rule Repository](https://khandal.tech/projects/sigma-rules): Vendor-agnostic detection rules mapped to MITRE ATT&CK for persistence and credential dumping.
- [Volatility 3 Memory Forensics Lab](https://khandal.tech/projects/memory-forensics-lab): Live malware extraction, process hollowing analysis, and unhooked DLL dumps.
- [Sysmon & EVTX Log Parser](https://khandal.tech/projects/log-parser): High-throughput Windows event log parser and threat indicator extractor.
- [Threat Intel Enrichment Bot](https://khandal.tech/projects/threat-intel-bot): Automated IOC enrichment bot querying VirusTotal, AbuseIPDB, and AlienVault OTX.
- [Network Traffic Monitor](https://khandal.tech/projects/network-monitor): Automated PCAP analyzer flagging C2 beaconing and data exfiltration patterns.
